notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Impact. Adaptive(58) Arc Sword Heavy Ammo. "Oh fun, a new adaptive frame sword. How many of these does it make? Too many. Bungie, please give us class agnostic lightweight and heavy swords. I promise Hunter’s want to run around with gorilla swords and Titans want ninja-mode. Warlocks just want more books swords too. I digress, over to the recommendations. Relentless Strikes for PvE is just bread and butter. Whirlwind Blade is the bread to Relentless Strikes’ butter. It’s a tale as old as Vanilla. However, Valiant Charge is incredibly fun in my testing and speed-runners or strike speed-runners might find some good use for this."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Impact. Adaptive(58) Arc Sword Heavy Ammo. "In PvP Valiant Charge and Energy Transfer are perfect together. Blocking gives you class ability energy and the zoomies. Enjoy :)"

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 56 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6hjWp0NaachsNymnN22FDL) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE roll for damage to Bosses in end-game content. First thing to say about the reprised Nasreddin (named for a legendary trickster figure in Muslin folklore) is that if you already have a decent arc sword, you can give this a miss, as there's nothing that really makes it stand out except, maybe, for a slightly higher base Impact stat, and the new Devrim Kay VIII Foundry origin trait which should make the heavy attack rechage rate a little faster, but it takes a long time to proc the higher tiers. For newer Guardians, the usual recommendations of Jagged Edge as the blade perk for additinal damage, Swordmaster's Guard for the guard perk to get the heavy attack up as fast as possible. Then Relentless Strikes as your support perk in the first trait column, which works well to return ammo against all enemies, and either Whirlwind Blade or Surrounded, to boost damage, for your signature perk in the second. Recommended MW: Impact, with a damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod
